sentence: Over six thousand runners took part in the city marathon last Sunday.
synonym: more than six thousand runners joined
synonymNote: 意思相同，表示超过六千名跑步者参与了活动

distractors.word: under six thousand runners took part
distractors.note: under表示少于，与原句意思相反

distractors.word: exactly six thousand runners took part
distractors.note: exactly表示恰好六千，不是超过六千
watched表示观看，不是参加比赛
